description: Point MDP validating arbitrary-LTL robust synthesis (imdp_solve ltlx): LTL -> deterministic (gen.)Buchi via Spot ltl2tgba, product, robust omega-regular via omega::maxGenBuchi. Refs: Sickert et al. CAV 2016; Hahn et al. TACAS 2020 (good-for-MDPs); Duret-Lutz et al. Spot 2.0.
provenance: 0->1->{2,3 each 0.5}; s2 labelled a and self-loops. P(F a)=P(G F a)=P(X X a)=0.5; P(G(a->X a))=1; P(a | X a)=0. Validated against Storm LTL on the point PRISM model.

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT ltlx == Storm Pmax=?[phi] on the point MDP for every formula. F/X/G(a->Xa) are OUTSIDE IMPaCT's hard-coded F/G/U/X/GF/FG/patrol fragment. Nondeterministic (co-Buchi, e.g. F G a) formulas are soundly rejected by ltlx -> use the `ltl` fragment (persistence); ISSUE-0016.
